defmodule DbPool.Connection do
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:socket, :ref, :state, :owner, :buffer]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    socket = connect_tcp(opts[:host], opts[:port])
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{socket: socket, ref: make_ref(), state: :idle, owner: nil, buffer: <<>>}}
  end

  def checkout(pid, caller) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:checkout, caller})
  end

  def checkin(pid, ref) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, {:checkin, ref})
  end

  def query(pid, sql, params) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:query, sql, params}, 30_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:checkout, caller}, _from, %{state: :idle} = conn) do
    new_ref = make_ref()
    {:reply, {:ok, new_ref}, %{conn | state: :checked_out, owner: caller, ref: new_ref}}
  end

  def handle_call({:checkout, _caller}, _from, %{state: :checked_out} = conn) do
    {:reply, {:error, :busy}, conn}
  end

  def handle_call({:query, sql, params}, _from, %{state: :checked_out} = conn) do
    result = execute_on_socket(conn.socket, sql, params)
    {:reply, result, conn}
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, ref}, %{ref: conn_ref} = conn) do
    if ref == conn_ref do
      {:noreply, %{conn | state: :idle, owner: nil}}
    else
      {:noreply, conn}
    end
  end

  defp connect_tcp(host, port) do
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.connect(to_charlist(host), port, [:binary, active: false])
    socket
  end

  defp execute_on_socket(socket, sql, params) do
    payload = Protocol.encode_query(sql, params)
    :gen_tcp.send(socket, payload)
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000) do
      {:ok, data} -> Protocol.decode_response(data)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end

defmodule DbPool.Manager do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    pool_size = opts[:pool_size] || 5
    connections = for _ <- 1..pool_size do
      {:ok, pid} = DbPool.Connection.start_link(opts)
      pid
    end
    {:ok, %{connections: connections, waiters: :queue.new(), monitors: %{}}}
  end

  def acquire(timeout \\ 5000) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :acquire, timeout)
  end

  def release(conn_pid, ref) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:release, conn_pid, ref})
  end

  def handle_call(:acquire, from, state) do
    case try_checkout(state.connections, from) do
      {:ok, conn_pid, ref, remaining} ->
        monitor_ref = Process.monitor(elem(from, 0))
        monitors = Map.put(state.monitors, monitor_ref, {conn_pid, ref})
        {:reply, {:ok, conn_pid, ref}, %{state | connections: remaining, monitors: monitors}}
      :none ->
        waiters = :queue.in(from, state.waiters)
        {:noreply, %{state | waiters: waiters}}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:release, conn_pid, ref}, state) do
    DbPool.Connection.checkin(conn_pid, ref)
    state = return_to_pool(conn_pid, state)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:DOWN, monitor_ref, :process, _pid, _reason}, state) do
    case Map.pop(state.monitors, monitor_ref) do
      {{conn_pid, ref}, monitors} ->
        DbPool.Connection.checkin(conn_pid, ref)
        state = %{state | monitors: monitors}
        state = return_to_pool(conn_pid, state)
        {:noreply, state}
      {nil, _} ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp try_checkout([], _from), do: :none
  defp try_checkout([conn | rest], from) do
    caller = elem(from, 0)
    case DbPool.Connection.checkout(conn, caller) do
      {:ok, ref} -> {:ok, conn, ref, rest}
      {:error, :busy} -> try_checkout(rest, from)
    end
  end

  defp return_to_pool(conn_pid, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.waiters) do
      {{:value, waiter}, remaining_waiters} ->
        caller = elem(waiter, 0)
        case DbPool.Connection.checkout(conn_pid, caller) do
          {:ok, ref} ->
            GenServer.reply(waiter, {:ok, conn_pid, ref})
            %{state | waiters: remaining_waiters}
          {:error, _} ->
            %{state | connections: [conn_pid | state.connections], waiters: remaining_waiters}
        end
      {:empty, _} ->
        %{state | connections: [conn_pid | state.connections]}
    end
  end
end

defmodule DbPool.AsyncQuery do
  @moduledoc "Async query interface with connection lifecycle management"

  def run_async(sql, params) do
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      {:ok, conn_pid, ref} = DbPool.Manager.acquire()
      try do
        DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, sql, params)
      after
        DbPool.Manager.release(conn_pid, ref)
      end
    end)
    task
  end

  def run_parallel(queries) when is_list(queries) do
    tasks = Enum.map(queries, fn {sql, params} ->
      run_async(sql, params)
    end)
    Task.yield_many(tasks, 10_000)
    |> Enum.map(fn
      {_task, {:ok, result}} -> result
      {task, nil} ->
        Task.shutdown(task, :brutal_kill)
        {:error, :timeout}
    end)
  end

  def run_transaction(queries) when is_list(queries) do
    {:ok, conn_pid, ref} = DbPool.Manager.acquire()
    try do
      DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, "BEGIN", [])
      results = Enum.map(queries, fn {sql, params} ->
        case DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, sql, params) do
          {:ok, result} -> result
          {:error, _} = err ->
            DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, "ROLLBACK", [])
            throw(err)
        end
      end)
      DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, "COMMIT", [])
      {:ok, results}
    catch
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    after
      DbPool.Manager.release(conn_pid, ref)
    end
  end

  def run_detached(sql, params, callback_pid) do
    Task.start(fn ->
      {:ok, conn_pid, ref} = DbPool.Manager.acquire()
      try do
        result = DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, sql, params)
        send(callback_pid, {:query_result, result})
      after
        DbPool.Manager.release(conn_pid, ref)
      end
    end)
    :ok
  end

  def run_fire_and_forget(sql, params) do
    Task.start(fn ->
      {:ok, conn_pid, ref} = DbPool.Manager.acquire()
      try do
        DbPool.Connection.query(conn_pid, sql, params)
      after
        DbPool.Manager.release(conn_pid, ref)
      end
    end)
    :ok
  end
end
